name: Fog
soul: The soul of one who softens whatever they touch, and is hard to find when an answer is wanted.
spark: The mote has no edge. Some mornings it is a point of light, and some mornings the whole room is slightly harder to see across.

hybrid.text: It is weather that came indoors and stayed. It hides what it likes and it likes you.

settled.name: Wisp of Fog
settled.text: A breath of fog that stays when the window is shut. It gathers on your shoulder when you are still and trails behind when you run.
settled.sign: A breath of fog that stays when the window is shut. It has no edge you can point to.
settled.habit: It gathers on your shoulder when you are still, and the page you are reading goes slightly soft.

paths.name: Fog-shroud
paths.of: one who gets between people and takes the heat out of it
paths.text: It learned from you that most blows land softer if somebody gets in the way gently. It gets in the way gently.
paths.sign: It hangs round you like a second coat, grey and close, and sounds reach you through it dulled.
paths.habit: It drifts between any two people who are arguing, and they find they have lowered their voices.

prongs.name: Ground-veil
prongs.of: one who covers for the whole party and is not asked how
prongs.text: It lies over the whole party on the approach. The pack smells you and cannot find you.
prongs.sign: It lies knee-deep and level over open ground, with the air standing clear above it.
prongs.habit: It settles over the floor of any room where people are sleeping.

finishes.name: Smuggler's Weather
finishes.of: one who gets a person through without anyone having seen
finishes.text: Nobody sees the passenger arrive. The house's man counts you twice and then stops asking.
finishes.sign: A blank grey face forms in it when it is looked at, and is nobody's.
finishes.habit: It thickens at the gate whenever someone wants to slip out, and has never been asked to.

finishes.name: Harbour Fog
finishes.of: one who closes round a hurt friend like a tide
finishes.text: It comes in round the cohort like a tide when one of you is hurt, and what was chasing loses the trail.
finishes.sign: It comes in low and quickly from all sides at once. There are old grey eyes in it that count.
finishes.habit: It rolls in round whoever of the cohort is in the infirmary, and stays the night.

prongs.name: Smother
prongs.of: one who takes the edge off whatever is coming
prongs.text: Blows that reach you through it arrive tired. Fires that reach you through it arrive out.
prongs.sign: It moves in slow folds like water, and things passing through it come out slower.
prongs.habit: It lies over the hearth when the fire spits, and the fire thinks better of it.

finishes.name: Dousing Mist
finishes.of: one who meets heat with patience until it is only steam
finishes.text: It drinks your foe's element and gives back steam. Turn-fire is a thing it finds delicious.
finishes.sign: Rime at its edges and steam at its heart. It hisses, faintly, all the time.
finishes.habit: It sits on anything too hot to touch until it can be touched.

finishes.name: Grey Pall
finishes.of: one who covers the fallen and will not be moved off them
finishes.text: When you are down it settles over you, grey and close. Nothing has yet come through it to finish the work.
finishes.sign: A heavy grey that lies like a blanket, with a cold still place at the centre.
finishes.habit: It lies close over you when you are ill, and has to be asked to lift for the doctor.

prongs.name: Choke-damp
prongs.of: one who makes a loud thing smaller
prongs.text: It goes down the foe's throat as the foe breathes in to roar. The roar is smaller.
prongs.sign: A low dense grey with a hollow in it like an open mouth. Candles dim when it passes.
prongs.habit: It hangs in front of anyone who is shouting until they cough.

finishes.name: Black Damp
finishes.of: one who sinks to the bottom of a thing and waits there
finishes.text: In the deep places it sinks to the floor and waits there. Things that live low stop living low.
finishes.sign: It lies along the floor, darker than fog should be, with two darker places that watch upward.
finishes.habit: It pools in the cellar and comes up the stairs one step a night.

finishes.name: Drowning Air
finishes.of: one in whose company everything is an effort
finishes.text: Close to, it is as thick as water. The foe swings as if wading.
finishes.sign: It is thick enough to push against. Hands moved through it leave a slow wake.
finishes.habit: It fills the stairwell on wet evenings, and everyone climbs as if wading.

paths.name: Lingering Mist
paths.of: one who cannot leave the place where it happened
paths.text: It learned from you that some places are not finished with. It stays where a thing happened, listening, long after everyone else has gone home.
paths.sign: It hangs in one spot in still air and does not thin. Sounds from long ago seem to carry in it.
paths.habit: It goes back to the same corner of the yard every evening and stays until dark.

prongs.name: Standing Fog
prongs.of: one who stays exactly where they were asked to
prongs.text: Told to stay, it stays: a wall with no stones in it. Things walk in and walk out the way they came.
prongs.sign: A flat grey wall across a gap, square at the edges, like a door with no handle.
prongs.habit: It fills the doorway of whatever room you are in and does not come further.

finishes.name: Fog-bank
finishes.of: one who sits on a place until the place is safe
finishes.text: It sits on a post like weather on a hill. The line's dark has learned it cannot see what it is attacking.
finishes.sign: It lies banked along the post like snow against a wall, with the lamp showing through as a low sun.
finishes.habit: It settles on the same stretch of wall each night and is there at dawn.

finishes.name: Sea-fret
finishes.of: one who comes when the crossing has to be made, and stays for it
finishes.text: It comes in off the water faster than a walking pace, and stays till you are across.
finishes.sign: It comes in off the water in long finned streamers, tasting of salt.
finishes.habit: It walks up the river each morning as far as the bridge, and goes back.

prongs.name: Grave Mist
prongs.of: one in whose company the dead can be seen
prongs.text: The shades of your hall walk in it at the lamp hour and can be seen. They asked it to come.
prongs.sign: Figures stand in it at the edge of sight. It looks at them with old eyes and does not point them out.
prongs.habit: It rises off the name-stones at the lamp hour and drifts to the hearth.

finishes.name: Mist of the Named Dead
finishes.of: one who holds on to the last of a person a moment longer
finishes.text: It holds the shape of each shade a moment after they have gone, so you can finish what you were saying.
finishes.sign: It holds a lit shape for a breath after a shade has gone: a shoulder, a turned head.
finishes.habit: It keeps the shape of whoever last left the room until you have finished speaking.

finishes.name: Trail-keeper
finishes.of: one who keeps a track fresh long after it should have gone
finishes.text: It hangs where a named beast has passed and shows you the print of it, hours old, in standing grey.
finishes.sign: It hangs in a line along the ground, and old prints show in it as if just made.
finishes.habit: It lies along the path you took yesterday, and the day before, in fainter grey.

prongs.name: Fog of Stillness
prongs.of: one who went somewhere empty and brought some of it back
prongs.text: It has been into the Quiet and came back thinner. It knows how to be where the field is not.
prongs.sign: It is thinner than it was and very still. Sound stops a hand's breadth inside it.
prongs.habit: It lies in the one room nobody uses, with the door shut.

finishes.name: The Quiet's Edge
finishes.of: one who marks the place past which you should not go
finishes.text: It marks where the Quiet begins, a grey wall you can see, so that you never again walk into it by mistake.
finishes.sign: A clean grey wall, straight as a rule, with the air stood still along it.
finishes.habit: It draws itself across the top of the cellar stairs at night.

finishes.name: Sudden Clearing
finishes.of: one who lifts, once, at the moment it matters
finishes.text: At the instant you parry it lifts, and the foe is standing in plain light with its guard open.
finishes.sign: It parts in the middle like a curtain, and a single clear eye of open air looks through.
finishes.habit: It clears from the window just as the person you were waiting for comes into the yard.

paths.name: Shifting Fog
paths.of: one who cannot be pinned to an answer
paths.text: It learned from you that a thing with no edge cannot be held to anything. Ask it a straight question and it is on the far side of the river.
paths.sign: It will not hold a shape. Look at one part and the rest has moved, off toward water.
paths.habit: It leaves by the gap under the door when a question is put to you both.

prongs.name: Fog-echo
prongs.of: one who answers with your own words from somewhere else
prongs.text: It gives the foe back its own voice from the wrong direction, and the foe goes to see.
prongs.sign: It has a voice, and the voice is always the last speaker's, from the wrong side of the room.
prongs.habit: It says the end of your sentence back to you a moment later, from the corridor.

finishes.name: Calling Mist
finishes.of: one who knows the name a person answers to, and uses it
finishes.text: Something in it calls the foe by a name it answers to. You have never heard what the name is.
finishes.sign: A face forms in it that is nearly somebody you know, and then a second behind the first.
finishes.habit: It says a name outside the window at night. It is never yours.

finishes.name: Lost-road
finishes.of: one who lets the other side lose their way, and keeps a clear account of it
finishes.text: The other house's car left before yours and has not arrived. It was foggy on their road. It was not on yours.
finishes.sign: It carries a damp ledger of arrivals. One column is all blanks.
finishes.habit: It lies across the fork in the road, on the branch you did not take.

prongs.name: Night-frost
prongs.of: one who settles a thing by waiting for it to stop moving
prongs.text: It settles at night on whatever stands still, and by morning that thing is white and slow.
prongs.sign: White needles on every edge of it, growing while you watch. It makes no sound at all.
prongs.habit: It settles on whatever in the room has been still longest, and that is sometimes you.

finishes.name: Hoar
finishes.of: one whose quiet is the kind that comes before a crack
finishes.text: Every edge it has touched wears white needles. It makes no sound. The breaking does.
finishes.sign: Long white feathers of ice with a blue cold at the root. They ring very faintly.
finishes.habit: It grows along the inside of the window overnight, in the pattern of ferns.

finishes.name: Black Ice
finishes.of: one who is not where they were, and what is left there is treacherous
finishes.text: You step aside, and it is already under the foe's feet where you were.
finishes.sign: Clear and dark and smooth as glass, lying flat. You see the ground through it and not it.
finishes.habit: It lies across the top step, and moves off when it hears you coming.

prongs.name: Driven Mist
prongs.of: one who is carried wherever the push is strongest
prongs.text: It goes where your shot goes, a grey line across the ground, and closes behind.
prongs.sign: It runs low and fast across open ground on long streaming legs, ahead of any wind.
prongs.habit: It races the car along the line and is waiting at the next post.

finishes.name: Rising Water
finishes.of: one who comes up slowly round a thing until it cannot move
finishes.text: Enough fog in one place is a river. It rises round the foe's knees, brown and patient.
finishes.sign: Brown water, knee-deep, with the fog standing on it. Roots and fence-posts show through.
finishes.habit: It fills any low place it finds: a ditch, a basin, your boots.

finishes.name: Storm-front
finishes.of: one who avoids and avoids, and then arrives all at once
finishes.text: It rolls in across open ground ahead of you, with your Pattern inside it like lightning in a cloud.
finishes.sign: A grey wall with a bright ring turning inside it, and light flickering behind.
finishes.habit: It builds on the horizon through the afternoon and is over the yard by supper.
